verdict.rationale: Morph is an LLM API platform, so event-driven automation is a fair axis, but the evidence never documents user-defined rules that automatically trigger actions on events. Reflexes are classifiers that label turns (e.g. stuck-in-a-loop, frustration), and the canary migration is 'gated by Reflexes'. Neither is shown to fire actions automatically; acting on the labels is left to the caller's own code.
